description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 3. Gross/net revenue with delta=rho=0 locked, storefront cut tau=0.30 applied, and the locked F2P policy (kept, revenue NULL) enforced.
signature: def estimate_revenue(sales: pd.DataFrame, price_usd: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Compute gross and net revenue bands.

Args:
    sales: estimate_sales' output (estimated_sales_low/mid/high).
    price_usd: P_i per appid; 0 for free-to-play titles.
    params: EnrichmentParams.storefront_cut (tau), discount_factor (delta, locked 0.0), refund_regional_factor (rho, locked 0.0).

Returns:
    A DataFrame with estimated_revenue_gross_usd and estimated_revenue_net_usd (single columns, computed from the MID sales estimate only, per the games_enriched schema which has one gross/net column pair, not per-band -- the low/high bands remain available via estimated_sales_low/high for any caller that wants to derive a revenue range itself). gross = sales_mid * price_usd; net = gross * (1 - tau). Free-to-play rows (price_usd == 0, or more precisely the row's is_free flag) get NaN (rendered 'unknown', never 0) for both columns, per FORMULATION.md section 2's locked F2P policy.
preconditions: params.discount_factor == 0.0 and params.refund_regional_factor == 0.0 (locked; estimate_revenue does not itself re-validate this since config.validate_parameters already enforces the [0,1] range, but the formula's simplicity -- no delta/rho terms applied -- assumes exactly the locked values; if a future FORMULATION.md revision unlocks non-zero delta/rho, this function's formula must be revisited, not silently reused)
postconditions: F2P rows (is_free True, or price_usd == 0) have NaN in both revenue columns, never 0.0
For a non-F2P row, estimated_revenue_net_usd == estimated_revenue_gross_usd * (1 - tau) exactly

edge_cases.input: price_usd == 0 for a title not flagged is_free (e.g. a bundle/soundtrack priced at $0 that is not actually F2P)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: treated as F2P for this formula's purposes -- the revenue formula is invalid for any zero-price row regardless of the is_free flag's precise semantics, per FORMULATION.md's phrasing 'F2P titles (P_i undefined as a sale price)'; NaN is used whenever price_usd == 0
gross and net both 0.0, not NaN -- this is a valid zero-revenue estimate, distinct from the F2P 'undefined price basis' case

unit_tests.name: test_reproduces_hand_computed_gross_and_net
unit_tests.description: sales_mid=1000, price_usd=10, tau=0.30 yields gross=10000, net=7000, per the module's own testing requirement.

unit_tests.name: test_free_to_play_yields_null_not_zero
unit_tests.description: price_usd=0 yields NaN for both revenue columns even though sales_mid > 0.
unit_tests.expected: gross is NaN, net is NaN

unit_tests.name: test_zero_reviews_nonfree_yields_zero_not_null
unit_tests.description: price_usd=10, sales_mid=0 yields gross=0.0, net=0.0 (not NaN).
